connectorUiConfig.title: Netcraft Integration Gateway
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
[Netcraft](https://www.netcraft.com/) brings takedown activity, domain detection results, Social (Fraud Detection) findings, and deep and dark web intelligence into Microsoft Sentinel, so external threats against your brand appear alongside your internal telemetry.

The connector ingests four data streams into dedicated tables:

- Takedown, into `NetcraftTakedown_CL`. New takedowns, important notes, blocked or waiting events, and status changes.
- Domain detection, into `NetcraftDomainDetection_CL`. New and updated domain results, with risk level, tags, and hosting detail.
- Social (Fraud Detection), into `NetcraftSocialResult_CL`, `NetcraftAppResult_CL`, `NetcraftAdvertResult_CL`, and `NetcraftSearchTask_CL`. Brand abuse and impersonation found across social media, advertising platforms, and mobile app stores.
- Deep and dark web, into `NetcraftDdwIntelligence_CL`. New intelligence matches covering credentials, cards, documents, domains, and mentions.

Events are polled on the schedule you choose. The solution also ships analytics rule templates, workbooks, and hunting queries, so detections and dashboards are available as soon as data arrives.

Field-level reference and event schemas: [https://api.netcraft.com/integration-gateway/v1](https://api.netcraft.com/integration-gateway/v1)

**Prerequisites**

To connect Netcraft to Microsoft Sentinel you need:

- Workspace: read and write permissions on the Sentinel workspace.
- Netcraft organisation API key: available from your Netcraft account.
- No additional Azure resources. The connector runs on the Codeless Connector Framework, so there is no Azure Function to deploy and no extra Azure consumption cost.

**Configuration**

Enter your Netcraft organisation API key, choose how often Sentinel should poll, then select Connect. Data typically appears in your workspace within one polling interval.

- Gateway base URL: `https://api.netcraft.com/integration-gateway/v1` (prefilled)
- Organisation API key
- Polling frequency

sampleQueries.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where EventType == "takedown"
| project TimeGenerated, ChangeType, TakedownId, GroupId, AttackType, Threat, IsMaliciousDomain, IsMaliciousHostname, Status, ActionRequired
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where EventType == "takedown"
| where isnotempty(ActionRequired) and ActionRequired != "no"
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

NetcraftTakedown_Latest
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

sampleQueries.description: Recent important notes and group tag changes
sampleQueries.query:
NetcraftTakedown_Unique
| where EventType in ("takedown-important-note", "takedown-important-note-updated", "takedown-important-note-deleted", "group-important-note", "group-important-note-updated", "group-important-note-deleted", "group-tag-change")
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where ChangeType == "new"
| where tostring(Risk.category) in ("highest", "high")
| project TimeGenerated, Hostname, Domain, Risk, ChangeType, CloudEventType, DomainResultId, AreaId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

NetcraftDomainDetection_Latest
| where tostring(Tags) contains "Newly Registered"
| project TimeGenerated, Hostname, Risk, Tags, DomainResultId, AreaId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

NetcraftDdwIntelligence_Latest
| where Priority == "high"
| project TimeGenerated, MatchUuid, GroupUuid, IntelligenceType, DisplayValue, Priority, MatchSource, Url, TakedownEligible
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

NetcraftSocialResult_Latest
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

NetcraftAppResult_Latest
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

NetcraftAdvertResult_Latest
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

NetcraftSearchTask_Latest
| project TimeGenerated, Product, ResultUuid, DisplayName, Url, RiskCategory, Reason, CloudEventType
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
| take 50

instructionSteps.title: Connect Netcraft Integration Gateway to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description: Provide the gateway base URL (including `/v1` for production), organisation API key, and polling frequency, then click Connect. Pollers send `connector=sentinel` automatically. Takedown (4 streams), Domain Detection (`/events/domain-detection/results`), Deep & Dark Web (`/events/deep-and-dark-web/matches`), Social, App, and Advert results, and the three task streams are polled with cursor pagination. Results use their own tables. Tasks share `NetcraftSearchTask_CL`.
